title: Tera Pilot backend report — schema v1
description: Machine-readable contract for one backend task run (TUI-backed automation adapter, CI, GitHub workflows, daemon). Produced by tera_pilot_tui.backend_runner.run_task(). Mirrored by the manual validator in tera_pilot_tui/backend_report.py (no jsonschema dependency). Status describes the run; verification.status describes the verification step; ok is the run-level success flag. Tool arguments are intentionally NOT exported — command/MCP payloads can contain secrets. final_output is potentially sensitive and must be treated as such by consumers.

status.description: Outcome of the run itself. success = task completed; failed = task ran but did not succeed; error = the run failed before producing a result (e.g. provider auth error).

error.description: Human-readable error message, null on success.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace the agent operated in. Identity, not content.

provider.description: Actual provider id used, not just a config hint.

model.description: Actual model name used, not just a config hint.

duration_sec.description: Wall-clock duration of the backend run.

tokens.description: Cumulative session tokens tracked by the usage tracker.

cost_usd.description: Cumulative session cost in USD tracked by the usage tracker.

tools.description: Tool calls with metadata only — raw arguments are never exported.

status.description: What the verification step actually did. An unrun check is never called successful.

test_result.description: Present only when the caller ran a test command as part of the task.

output.description: Potentially sensitive — redacted from reports by default.

final_output.description: Potentially sensitive — the agent's final answer. May contain repository code.

audit_ref.description: Optional reference to the signed audit export for this run (e.g. path or export id).

metadata.description: Optional run metadata. Sanitized to JSON-safe values by the producer.
